a15.title: Pave Open Heart Studs
a15.descriptionHtml:
A heart drawn in light. Each stud is a bold open heart of about 20mm in polished gold tone, its broad outline set with two rows of tiny clear cubic zirconia, with the centre left open.

STYLING TIP: Pair them with the Pearl Heart Layered Necklace.

Details

  • Size: Approximately 20mm across and 19mm tall
  • Stones: Two rows of tiny clear cubic zirconia round the outline
  • Fitting: Stud
  • Sold as: One pair
  • Finish: Polished gold tone
  • Material: Stainless steel, as on the supplier's card

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

a16.title: V-Bar Teardrop Necklace
a16.descriptionHtml:
A polished V and one clear drop. A gold tone curb chain about 3.5mm wide turns into two smooth gold tone bars that meet in a V at the front, and a pear cut clear cubic zirconia of about 10 x 13mm hangs point up from the point of the V.

STYLING TIP: Wear it alone with a white top or a deep neckline.

Details

  • Chain: Curb chain with faceted links, approximately 3.5mm wide
  • Front: Two polished bars, approximately 15mm each, meeting in a V
  • Drop: Pear cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 10 x 13mm, hanging point up in a claw setting
  • Length: Approximately 45cm (to confirm)
  • Material: 316L stainless steel with a PVD gold tone finish, as labelled by the supplier

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
